note: No public ArcGIS REST or downloadable zoning district layer found for De Soto Parish or its cities (Mansfield, Stonewall, Logansport). The parish's ArcGIS services on services8.arcgis.com (DESOTO_JP, DeSoto_911_Jul25) hold justice-of-peace districts, 911 addresses, city limits and parish boundary, not zoning. Parish handles building permits through the Police Jury; Mansfield's Planning & Zoning page exposes no GIS link. Only commercial aggregators (Zoneomics, Regrid) show zoning.
